source_refs.note: 2- Oviducts (Fallopian tubes): a main subheading of 17.1.2 Female Reproductive System, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 77-77.

blocks.text: Oviducts (jinhein fallopian tubes ya uterine tubes bhi kehte hain) do nalyan hain jo ovaries se uterus tak jati hain. Jab ovum pak jata hai to ovarian follicle aur ovary ki deewar phat kar use bahar nikalti hain. Ovum oviduct mein dakhil ho kar uterus ki taraf safar karta hai. Is harkat mein oviduct ki andaruni teh ke cilia (baal jaise ubhaar) madad dete hain. Ovum ka fertilization bhi oviduct hi mein hota hai, aur banne wala zygote oviduct mein rehte hue hi kai dafa mitosis se taqseem hota hai.
